questions.q: When did Ivana move to Belgrade?
questions.e: I moved here a month ago.

questions.q: Where can dogs run without a leash?
o: In the fenced part of the park

questions.q: Where should you throw the bag?
o: Into the green bin next to the bench
questions.e: Into the green bin next to the bench.

questions.q: What can happen if you do not clean up after your dog?
questions.e: If you do not clean up, you can get a fine.

questions.q: What is compulsory for a dog in Serbia?
o: Register it at the vet and get a microchip
questions.e: You must register him at the vet and microchip him, it is compulsory.

questions.q: What did Ivana tell the girl about Riki?
o: That he does not bite, but likes to sniff first
That he must not be touched
questions.e: He does not bite, but likes to sniff you first.

questions.q: What did the mother say before the girl petted someone else's dog?
questions.e: you should always ask the owner.

questions.q: What did Riki do while the dogs were playing?
o: Picked something up from the ground and started chewing
questions.e: Riki picked something up from the ground.

questions.q: *Mešanac*. Ne znamo tačno šta je sve u njemu.
Samo polako, malo je *stidljiv*.
Toga jutra je u park došla sa *povocem* u jednoj ruci
Doveli smo ga iz *skloništa*.
Bio je gladan i *mokar*.
Vuk je pravi *mazalica*.
I *vakcina* protiv besnila je svake godine.
Mama, vidi kuče! Može li da ga ___?
questions.e: Da + 1st person: da ga pomazim (“may I pet him”; for a dog you say maziti / pomaziti).

questions.q: Toga jutra je u park došla sa ___ u jednoj ruci i kesicom u drugoj.
Ivana je ___ glavom i otišla do ograđenog prostora.
Pored ___ psa stajao je visok mladić sa slušalicama.
Ja sam svog ___ ispred zgrade.
questions.e: Nemanja, a man, is speaking: našao.
